entities.summary: Sir Edward Coley Burne-Jones, 1st Baronet, was an English painter and designer associated with the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood's style and subject matter. Edward Burne-Jones was a authors & novelists from Birmingham (1833-08-28, Birmingham–1898-06-17). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
